whoqol-bref/q20.why: Close relationships; Relationship is the nearest pain, with Family and Friends beside it.

whoqol-bref/q22.why: Support: "I have no one to call when I need help."

oecd-wellbeing/social-connections.why: The dimension as a whole; Loneliness is its headline measure.

oecd-wellbeing/no-close-family.why: Having no close family mostly means having no one to turn to; estrangement is the close-friends and estranged-family candidates.

oecd-wellbeing/face-to-face.why: Invitations: seeing people in person less often.

sdg-targets/5.2.why: Safety at home: "I don't feel safe with someone in my life."

sdg-targets/5.3.why: Forced or child marriage is one way someone is unsafe with a person in their life; rare in the U.S.

sdg-targets/5.4.why: Unpaid care: Caregiving; unpaid housework is Chores.

sdg-targets/16.1.why: Violence in general is the societal Crime pain.

sdg-targets/16.2.why: Violence against children at home is covered loosely by Safety at home; harm in childhood that still hurts is Trauma.

maxneef/affection.why: Affection: closeness with friends, family and partners.

maxneef/participation.why: Belonging: being part of groups and communities.

maxneef/identity.why: Identity: "I don't know who I am any more."

gallup-elements/social.why: Strong relationships and love; Loneliness is the broadest People pain.

gallup-mip/family-decline.why: Moral decline: a societal worry, not a personal People pain.

gallup-mip/lack-of-respect.why: Moral decline covers people treating each other worse.

gallup-mip/childrens-needs.outOfScope: too broad for one pain; the societal Kids group covers children's needs

gallup-mip/elderly-care.why: Aging: "I see older people left on their own."

211-impact-2025/family-support.outOfScope: a catch-all service category with no single pain

who-people/isolation-older-young.why: Social isolation; for older people also the societal Aging pain.

who-people/elder-abuse.why: Abuse by someone an older person trusts is Safety at home.

cdc-nisvs/stalking.why: Being stalked by a partner or ex is not feeling safe with someone in my life.

cdc-nisvs/before-18.why: Violence first experienced as a teenager; what still hurts later is Trauma.

aarp-caregiving-2025/financial-impact.why: Caregiving "takes everything", including money; paying to support family is Supporting family.

aarp-caregiving-2025/isolated.why: Isolation from caregiving is part of what it takes; Loneliness also covers it.

aarp-caregiving-2025/sandwich.why: Caring for an adult while raising kids: Caregiving and Parenting together.

aarp-caregiving-2025/working.why: Juggling care with a job; Caregiving covers it loosely, Busy covers the time.

survey-center-friendship-2021/lost-touch.why: Friends: "I've lost touch with people who matter."

wikidata/Q7551008.why: Social connectedness, the opposite of loneliness.

wikidata/Q1137463.why: Sexual difficulties are one reason for missing closeness; the medical side is a Body matter.

wikidata/Q55492423.why: Family: "I'm caught in fighting at home."

wikidata/Q163942.why: Being stalked is not feeling safe with someone in my life.

wikidata/Q167191.why: For a child now, Safety at home; for an adult looking back, Trauma.

wikidata/Q500180.why: Caring for parents while raising kids.
